findings.comment: Building finished floor elevations are inconsistent across sheets: Building 1 shown as FFE 687.50 on Sheet 29 but 688.50 on Sheet 30 (0.50-ft difference); Building 3 shown as FFE 685.50 on Sheet 29 but 688.0 on Sheet 30 (2.50-ft difference). Conflicts must be reconciled and authoritative sheet identified.

Sheet 30 contains a cross-reference note stating 'REFER SHEET 28 FOR TREE LIST,' but Sheet 28 contains Construction Details 7 (storm drain manholes and catch basins). The Tree List is located on Sheet 32. Incorrect sheet number must be corrected to reference Sheet 32.

Sheet 23 contains duplicate fire hydrant installation notes appearing in both Block 7 and Block 9, with identical content. Duplicate construction details must be consolidated into a single authoritative instance and removed from secondary locations.
